subtitle: Huge Aberration (Plant), Lawful Evil | CR 15
details:
Huge Aberration (Plant), Lawful Evil
A floating arboreal horror grown in zero gravity. Its trunk twists into a hovering mass of bark and root, while a massive central eye glares from a hollowed heartwood core. Smaller eyestalks sprout like branches tipped with blinking, glowing pupils.
It does not walk. It drifts.

The Beholder-Treant hovers naturally and ignores difficult terrain.

At the start of each of its turns, the Beholder-Treant chooses a 60-foot cone.
Creatures in that cone are affected by an antimagic field until the start of its next turn.
Magical effects and spells are suppressed in that area.
Aberrant Arbor Core
At the start of its turn, it regains 15 HP while within 60 ft. of natural ground or stone.
If it takes fire damage, this regeneration is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

Multiattack
The Beholder-Treant uses three random Eye Rays and makes one Root Slam attack.

Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target.

The Beholder-Treant spins violently.

Gains +2 AC
Regains 15 HP at the start of its turn
Its attacks deal +1d8 force damage

Creatures of the Angel’s choice that start their turn within 10 feet take 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

The Angel fires a 60-foot line of radiant arcane energy.
Creatures in the line must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw:
Failure: 45 (10d8) radiant + force damage
Success: Half damage
Constructs and aberrations take maximum damage on a failed save.

Intercept Protocol
When a creature within 10 ft. of the Angel is hit by an attack, the Angel may swap places with that creature and become the target instead.
